DriverEnvironment.description: The ATW_* and process environment the driver hands child and orchestrator processes.
DriverEnvironment.x-details: headlessenv.child_env(scratch) returns these keys over the inherited os.environ (atw.environment fills only absent or blank values); the keeper, supervisor and orchestrator dispatch add ATW_STOP_FILE, ATW_EXECUTION_ID and ATW_ORCH_IDLE.

ATW_PROJECT_ROOT.description: Absolute path of the project root.

ATW_PRD_EPIC_SYNC.description: Path of the PRD-to-Epic sync script.

ATW_PRD_EPIC_VERIFY.description: Path of the PRD-to-Epic verify script.

ATW_CONTROL_REPO.description: Absolute path of the control repository (the project's control repository, else the driver's repository root). The driver modules live under it at DRIVER_DIR_PARTS.

ATW_ARCH_PATH.description: The architecture root; set only when the driver knows one. Readers use args.archPath first and fall back to it.

ATW_DESIGN_PACKAGES_DIR.description: The owner's cds design packages directory; optional.

PATH.description: The controller runtime's bin directory first, de-duplicated.

CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS.description: Disables the Claude CLI print-mode background wait.

ATW_STOP_FILE.description: Path of the stop marker file; absent means no stop marker. A consumer touches the file (mode 0o600) to request a drain, or tests whether it exists. It only requests a stop: how a stop is classified belongs to the handback contract.

ATW_EXECUTION_ID.description: The driver execution id. Required for an orchestrator dispatch; set for a headless workflow session only when its arguments carry an executionId.

ATW_ORCH_IDLE.description: Orchestrator idle limit in seconds: a positive finite float. A non-finite or non-positive value is a ValueError.

ATW_SESSION_IDLE.description: Agent session idle limit in seconds: a session that writes no stream line for this long is ended with cause timeout. A positive finite float; a non-finite or non-positive value is a ValueError.

ATW_SESSION_LIMIT.description: Agent session hard limit in seconds for an agent whose definition states no x-sessionLimit: a session running this long is ended with cause timeout. A positive finite float; a non-finite or non-positive value is a ValueError.

ATW_SUBAGENT_IDLE.description: Subagent stall limit in seconds: while an Agent call of a session is open, a subagent transcript that has written nothing for this long ends the session with cause timeout. A positive finite float; a non-finite or non-positive value is a ValueError.

ATW_HEARTBEAT.description: Seconds between the heartbeats a running agent session announces. A positive finite float; a non-finite or non-positive value is a ValueError.

StopFileMode.description: Permission bits a consumer creates the stop marker file with.

DeniedTool.description: A tool every headless build and deploy Workflow session the driver dispatches is denied. DENIED_TOOLS keeps this order.

TerminateGrace.description: Seconds a terminated child process is given before it is killed.

ExhaustedUtilization.description: A usage window whose utilization is at or above this value is exhausted.

RateLimitStatus.description: RateLimitInfo.status; only rejected is acted on.

UsageWindowName.description: The account-wide usage windows. Any other window name is model-specific.

UsageWindow.description: One usage window of a RateLimitInfo.

utilization.description: Exhausted when at or above EXHAUSTED_UTILIZATION.

RateLimitInfo.description: The rate_limit_info of a rate_limit_event: the info argument of the quota readers.

resetsAt.description: Top-level reset time in epoch seconds.

rateLimitType.description: The value with meaning here is MODEL_OVERAGE_TYPE.

overageDisabledReason.description: The value with meaning here is OUT_OF_CREDITS_REASON.

RateLimitEvent.description: One Claude CLI stream-json rate-limit event.
